ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start an instance with a custom extension

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-load\\-extension\\=.*"))
